description: Add a new client to the directory or update an existing client with accounting CRM metadata (entity type, filing cadence, FYE, state, tags, masked tax ID, pinned accountant notes, and linked contacts).

entityType.description: Tax entity classification (e.g. "individual" for 1040, "s_corp" for 1120-S, "c_corp" for 1120, "partnership" for 1065)

linkedContacts.description: Associated contacts, spouses, bookkeepers, or family members

maskedId.description: Masked tax ID / SSN / EIN (last 4 digits only, e.g. "1234" or "***-**-1234")

name.description: Full name of the client (e.g. "Jane Doe")

notes.description: General internal notes about this client

pinnedNote.description: Sticky internal accountant note (communication quirks, deadline habits)

qboId.description: QuickBooks Online or Xero accounting customer ID

stateOfFiling.description: US State abbreviation for tax filing (e.g. "FL", "CA", "NY")

taxSoftwareId.description: Drake, UltraTax, or CCH Axcess client ID

name: create_or_update_client
